goal: Expose HD key derivation to the GUI so multisig wallet setup can derive and show a shareable xpub
Solves the gap where the derivehdkey RPC logic is unreachable outside RPC calls
reviewability: Ready but risky to review now, author is mid-restructuring per a reviewer's proposed commit sequence
An open RPC error-code compatibility question awaits a maintainer decision, review could be invalidated
agreement: Concept ACKs from multiple reviewers supporting the interface itself (polespinasa, jeanpablojp, pseudoramdom)
Unaddressed objection: collapsing RPC error codes may break the v32 error contract, no maintainer decision yet (pseudoramdom)
Author has offered a fix (duplicating checks) but it is not yet resolved (PraneethGunas)
Earlier code-duplication objection was resolved by unifying the implementation (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it is a scoped building block rather than an urgent fix
Unblocks the Multisig Wizard GUI project (#35645) by letting the GUI derive a shareable xpub
Only public key material crosses the interface so there is no fund-safety exposure, and delay is not costly since the RPC already ships
